title: source-kb: external published sources
description: Index of externally published sources (FHEQ/CQFW sector frameworks, QAA subject benchmarks, subject literature) - public, versioned by their issuers (S1-D8). Entries index and characterise sources; they never duplicate source text (pointer discipline, F9). A new issuer edition is a NEW entry; the old entry gains supersededBy (ordinary supersession, S3-D3; absence of supersededBy means current). Designed away-week Session 4 (S4-D1-D6).

id.description: Issuer-prefixed by convention (qaa/criminology-2022, fheq/2024, lit/<slug>). The prefix is legibility only; mechanical matching uses fields, never id parsing (S4-D2).

issuerVersion.description: The source's own edition/version as published. Omit where the issuer does not version. Presence requires retrieved (draft-07 dependency).

sourceType.description: DELIBERATELY open pre-sourcing (S4-D3); tighten to an enum at population once real material is in hand. Expected values: framework, benchmark, literature.

authorityLevel.description: source-kb's half of the four-level vocabulary (S1-D8 restated per store, validated here); union across both stores matches gates' sourceConsultation.authorityLevels exactly, so gate-to-entry resolution is mechanical (S4-D4).

characterisation.description: Short prose: what the source contains and what it can ground. Index-and-characterise, never duplicate.

supersededBy.description: Entry id of the superseding entry (new issuer edition). Absence = current.
